tool_input.command:
mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/compression.md <<'EOF'
# Transport compression policy

The project's current recorded decision is to use zstd as the transport compression codec, chosen because it compresses better than the alternative previously in use and decompresses much faster on both ends of the connection.
EOF
cat docs/policies/compression.md
